verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ חִלְקִיָּ֑הוּ מִן־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּעֲנָת֔וֹת בְּאֶ֖רֶץ בִּנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê yir·mə·yā·hū ben- ḥil·qî·yā·hū min- hak·kō·hă·nîm ’ă·šer ba·‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ bə·’e·reṣ bin·yā·min
verses.literal: [These are] the words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah one of the priests - in Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ הָיָ֤ה אֵלָ֔יו בִּימֵ֛י בִּשְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה לְמָלְכֽוֹ׃ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh ’ê·lāw bî·mê biš·lōš- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lə·mā·lə·ḵōw yō·šî·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wn me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: - The word of the LORD came to [Jeremiah] . . . in the thirteenth . . . year of the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּימֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַד־ תֹּם֙ הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃ס בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְצִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה עַד־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם גְּל֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: way·hî bî·mê yə·hō·w·yā·qîm ben- yō·šî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ- tōm ha·ḥă·mî·šî ba·ḥō·ḏeš ‘aš·tê ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lə·ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ḇen- yō·šî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh ‘aḏ- yə·rū·šā·lim gə·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: and through the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah until . . . the fifth month of the eleventh . . . year of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah when the people of Jerusalem went into exile
The word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: בְּטֶ֨רֶם אֶצּוֹרְךָ בַבֶּ֙טֶן֙ יְדַעְתִּ֔יךָ וּבְטֶ֛רֶם תֵּצֵ֥א מֵרֶ֖חֶם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּ֑יךָ נְתַתִּֽיךָ׃ נָבִ֥יא לַגּוֹיִ֖ם
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem ʾɛṣ·ṣō·rə·ḵå̄ ḇab·be·ṭen yə·ḏa‘·tî·ḵā ū·ḇə·ṭe·rem tê·ṣê mê·re·ḥem hiq·daš·tî·ḵā nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā nā·ḇî lag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you and before you were born . . . I set you apart [and] appointed you as a prophet to the nations

verses.original: אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֔ה וָאֹמַ֗ר הִנֵּ֥ה לֹא־ יָדַ֖עְתִּי דַּבֵּ֑ר כִּי־ אָנֹֽכִי׃פ נַ֖עַר
verses.transliteration: ’ă·hāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wā·’ō·mar hin·nêh lō- yā·ḏa‘·tî dab·bēr kî- ’ā·nō·ḵî na·‘ar
verses.literal: Ah Lord GOD I said I surely do not know how to speak for I [am] only a child

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַ֔י אַל־ תֹּאמַ֖ר אָנֹ֑כִי נַ֣עַר כִּ֠י עַֽל־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֶֽשְׁלָחֲךָ֙ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוְּךָ֖ תְּדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ’al- tō·mar ’ā·nō·ḵî na·‘ar kî ‘al- kāl- ’ă·šer ’eš·lā·ḥă·ḵā tê·lêḵ wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·ṣaw·wə·ḵā tə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: But the LORD told me Do not say I [am] only a child For to everyone - I send you you must go - and all that I command you you must speak

verses.original: אַל־ תִּירָ֖א מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֛י אִתְּךָ֥ לְהַצִּלֶ֖ךָ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rā mip·pə·nê·hem kî- ’ă·nî ’it·tə·ḵā lə·haṣ·ṣi·le·ḵā nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Do not be afraid of them for I [am] with you to deliver you declares the LORD

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יָד֔וֹ וַיַּגַּ֖ע עַל־ פִּ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י הִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי דְבָרַ֖י בְּפִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·yiš·laḥ yā·ḏōw way·yag·ga‘ ‘al- pî way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay hin·nêh nā·ṯat·tî ḏə·ḇā·ray bə·p̄î·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the LORD - reached out His hand touched . . . my mouth and said . . . to me Behold I have put My words in your mouth

verses.original: רְאֵ֞ה הִפְקַדְתִּ֣יךָ׀ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה עַל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ וְעַל־ הַמַּמְלָכ֔וֹת לִנְת֥וֹשׁ וְלִנְת֖וֹץ וּלְהַאֲבִ֣יד וְלַהֲר֑וֹס לִבְנ֖וֹת וְלִנְטֽוֹעַ׃פ
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh hip̄·qaḏ·tî·ḵā hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ‘al- hag·gō·w·yim wə·‘al- ham·mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ lin·ṯō·wōš wə·lin·ṯō·wṣ ū·lə·ha·’ă·ḇîḏ wə·la·hă·rō·ws liḇ·nō·wṯ wə·lin·ṭō·w·a‘
verses.literal: See I have appointed you today . . . over nations . . . and kingdoms to uproot and tear down to destroy and overthrow to build and plant

verses.original: דְבַר־ יְהוָה֙ וַיְהִ֤י אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֔ר יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ מָה־ אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה אֲנִ֥י רֹאֶֽה׃ מַקֵּ֥ל שָׁקֵ֖ד וָאֹמַ֕ר
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lay lê·mōr yir·mə·yā·hū māh- ’at·tāh rō·’eh ’ă·nî rō·’eh maq·qêl šā·qêḏ wā·’ō·mar
verses.literal: And the word of the LORD came to me asking Jeremiah what do you see I see a branch of an almond tree I replied

verses.original: לִרְא֑וֹת הֵיטַ֣בְתָּ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֛י שֹׁקֵ֥ד עַל־ דְּבָרִ֖י לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lir·’ō·wṯ hê·ṭaḇ·tā way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay kî- ’ă·nî šō·qêḏ ‘al- də·ḇā·rî la·‘ă·śō·ṯōw
verses.literal: You have observed correctly said the LORD - for I am watching over My word to accomplish it

verses.original: שֵׁנִ֣ית דְבַר־ יְהוָ֤ה׀ וַיְהִ֨י אֵלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֔ה נָפ֙וּחַ֙ סִ֤יר וָאֹמַ֗ר וּפָנָ֖יו מִפְּנֵ֥י צָפֽוֹנָה׃
verses.transliteration: šê·nîṯ ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’ê·lay lê·mōr māh ’at·tāh rō·’eh ’ă·nî rō·’eh nā·p̄ū·aḥ sîr wā·’ō·mar ū·p̄ā·nāw mip·pə·nê ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Again the word of the LORD came to me asking What do you see I see a boiling pot I replied and it is tilting toward us from the north

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֑י הָרָעָ֔ה מִצָּפוֹן֙ תִּפָּתַ֣ח עַ֥ל כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāy hā·rā·‘āh miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn tip·pā·ṯaḥ ‘al kāl- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me Disaster from the north will be poured out on all who live in the land

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ הִנְנִ֣י קֹרֵ֗א לְכָֽל־ מִשְׁפְּח֛וֹת מַמְלְכ֥וֹת צָפ֖וֹנָה נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה וּבָ֡אוּ אִ֨ישׁ וְֽנָתְנוּ֩ כִּסְא֜וֹ פֶּ֣תַח׀ שַׁעֲרֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וְעַ֤ל כָּל־ סָבִ֔יב וְעַ֖ל חוֹמֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ כָּל־ עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nî qō·rê lə·ḵāl miš·pə·ḥō·wṯ mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh nə·’um- Yah·weh ū·ḇā·’ū ’îš wə·nā·ṯə·nū kis·’ōw pe·ṯaḥ ša·‘ă·rê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·‘al kāl- sā·ḇîḇ wə·‘al ḥō·w·mō·ṯe·hā kāl- ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: For . . . I am about to summon all the clans and kingdoms of the north declares the LORD [Their kings] will come . . . and set up their thrones at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem They will attack all her surrounding . . . walls and all the other cities of Judah

verses.original: וְדִבַּרְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּטַי֙ אוֹתָ֔ם עַ֖ל כָּל־ רָעָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּנִי וַֽיְקַטְּרוּ֙ אֲחֵרִ֔ים לֵאלֹהִ֣ים וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לְמַעֲשֵׂ֥י יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏib·bar·tî miš·pā·ṭay ’ō·w·ṯām ‘al kāl- rā·‘ā·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ă·zā·ḇū·nî way·qaṭ·ṭə·rū ’ă·ḥê·rîm lê·lō·hîm way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lə·ma·‘ă·śê yə·ḏê·hem
verses.literal: I will pronounce My judgments against them for all their wickedness because they have forsaken Me and they have burned incense to other gods and worshiped the works of their own hands

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ תֶּאְזֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֔יךָ וְקַמְתָּ֙ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑ךָּ אַל־ תֵּחַת֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם פֶּֽן־ אֲחִתְּךָ֖ לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh te’·zōr mā·ṯə·ne·ḵā wə·qam·tā wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·ṣaw·we·kā ’al- tê·ḥaṯ mip·pə·nê·hem pen- ’ă·ḥit·tə·ḵā lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: Get yourself ready . . . Stand up and tell . . . them everything that I command you Do not be intimidated by them or I will terrify you before them

verses.original: הִנֵּ֧ה הַיּ֗וֹם וַאֲנִ֞י נְתַתִּ֣יךָ מִבְצָ֜ר לְעִ֨יר בַּרְזֶ֛ל וּלְעַמּ֥וּד נְחֹ֖שֶׁת וּלְחֹמ֥וֹת עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ לְמַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ לְשָׂרֶ֔יהָ לְכֹהֲנֶ֖יהָ וּלְעַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh hay·yō·wm wa·’ă·nî nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā miḇ·ṣār lə·‘îr bar·zel ū·lə·‘am·mūḏ nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·lə·ḥō·mō·wṯ ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh lə·śā·re·hā lə·ḵō·hă·ne·hā ū·lə·‘am hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now behold this day I have made you like a fortified city an iron pillar and bronze walls against the whole land against the kings of Judah its officials its priests and the people of the land

verses.original: וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְלֹא־ י֣וּכְלוּ לָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֛י אִתְּךָ֥ לְהַצִּילֶֽךָ׃פ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·nil·ḥă·mū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·lō- yū·ḵə·lū lāḵ kî- ’ă·nî ’it·tə·ḵā lə·haṣ·ṣî·le·ḵā nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: They will fight against you but will never overcome you since I am with you to deliver you declares the LORD
